crossRefs.note: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne…
It will happen that everyone who is left in your house will come and bow down to him for a piece of silver and a loaf…
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their…

translations.web: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.
translations.bsb: His strength is depleted, and calamity is ready at his side.
translations.kjv: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
translations.asv: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And calamity shall be ready at his side.
